_readme: Every reward, price and shop rule lives here. Edit numbers, save, reload the game. The game reads 'rewards', 'events' and 'shop'. All shop items below are PLACEHOLDER test data - names, prices and effects are just there so the shop has something to show (effects are not applied yet). See docs/ECONOMY.md for what every field means, and run 'py tools/economy_report.py' for a quick balance table.
_aimNote: Speed of the two aim markers (offset and strength - always the same speed). markerHz = full back-and-forth sweeps per second at streak 0 (0.85 = one sweep in ~1.2s). Every consecutive hit of the current streak speeds BOTH markers up by streakSpeedUp (0.1 = +10% of the base speed per streak level, so streak 10 is 2x and the 3x cap comes at streak 20), never above maxSpeedMultiplier. The streak is read when the player taps 'TAP to aim', so the speed is fixed during a throw. Buffs and projectiles do NOT change it.
_projectilesNote: Gameplay numbers for every projectile you can equip (the id must match a shop projectile / the PROJECTILES list). weight: NOT shown to the player - heavier projectiles fly lower with the same throw strength (100 = the reference snowball; a weight of 80 flies 25% higher). angleRange: how far the throw can drift sideways (1 = the full swing, 0.8 = only 80% as far). The aim bar always keeps its width and shows this range edge to edge, so its graduation lines look stretched on a smaller range. The marker itself always moves at the same fixed speed. coinMultiplier: multiplies the coins for a hit, rounded DOWN. leavesMark: false = no snow mark on the wall, it bounces off instead. spins: the projectile rotates in flight.

shop._priceOverrideNote: PLACEHOLDER: while priceOverride is a number, EVERY item costs that many coins in the shop (so we can test buying). Set it to null to use each item's real 'price' below.
shop._restockNote: After buying, that slot shows SOLD OUT for this many seconds (by the device clock, so it also counts while the app is closed), then restocks. 60 = 1 minute for testing; 3600 = 1 hour.

refill._categoryWeightsNote: Odds of each TYPE when a slot is (re)stocked: projectile 1 vs consumable 9 = a projectile shows up about 1 time in 10. Then an item of that type is picked at random.

shop._itemsNote: Empty slots show (TBD) - the shop only has real items now. Optional item field image = a picture path for the card. Consumables are timed BUFFS: bought = active right away for duration.seconds, with a list of effects (precision, strengthControl, coinMultiplier - see src/buffs.js). category is 'consumable' (common, can be bought again and again, and can be on sale in two slots at once; needs a duration) or 'projectile' (rare, bought once and kept, never on sale twice).
